description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories used in the study “Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization.” It is divided into 13 distinct segments, each labeled with a content category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, “People Blogs,” accounts for 17.2% and is colored in a medium brown tone. The second largest is “Entertainment” at 13.9%, shown in purple. “Howto Style” follows at 9.7% in green, and “Education” at 8.7% in reddish-brown. “Film Animation” (4.6%, dark gray), “Sports” (7.7%, lavender), “Gaming” (6.4%, gray), “Travel Events” (4.6%, olive green), “Comedy” (5.6%, teal), “Science Technology” (6.4%, blue-gray), “News Politics” (4.3%, tan), “Pets Animals” (3.9%, light green), and “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%, maroon) make up the remaining segments. “Music” is the smallest category at 2.3%, shown in a very light purple. All percentages are displayed inside their respective slices, and the chart uses a muted color palette with no legend, relying on direct labeling. The segments appear to be arranged in roughly descending order clockwise from the top-right, though not strictly sorted. No slices are exploded or emphasized visually beyond their proportional size.
